notes.title: HUGE UPDATE!!! Siege Mode, Puckle Guns, Mortars & more!
notes.notes:
Heyo! This is a huge update for RoL with tons of new content including the long awaited Siege Mode & Puckle guns. 

 What is Siege Mode?

Siege Mode is a strategic wave defense mode where you earn money to buy more troops and defenses to fortify your fort as endless waves of enemies attack from all directions! You can place puckle guns, cannons, & mortars to assist you defending & waves get increasingly difficult to survive. 

 Leaving Early Access
 The game reached  the point where it can leave early access! YAY!!!!
Don't worry I will still keep updating the game frequently!


 The Developers Highest Wave

The highest wave I have been able to reach in siege mode is wave 15, so I challenge you all to try and beat it!



 Full Patch Notes

1. Siege Mode

2. Puckle Gun

3. Mortar

4. Greatly improved graphics

5. +20% optimization

6. TONS of bug fixes

7. All new particle effects

8. New map (for siege mode)

9. Improved Translations

10. New cinematic mode (can be enabled in options)

11. Improved UI

12. Fixed friendly fire with cannons

13. Fixed Navmesh bugs




Thank you for all the support! 

 Discord Server

You can join it here: discord.gg/rol

notes.title: UPDATE! Fixed crashing on mac, UI improvements!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, this is a small update to fix the crashes on mac computers, increase the density of trees on the old vegetation and improved UI.



If the game is crashing on mac for you, it is probably because the graphics settings are up too high.

If you can't reach the main menu to edit your graphics settings follow these steps.

1. Right click the game in your library.
2. Click properties.
3. Click Local Files.
4. Click Browse Local Files.
5. Open "RoL Crash Fix" and set all the quality settings to minimum.

If this helped let me know in the comments below! 

Also, Join our discord: discord.gg/rol

notes.title: NEW UPDATE IS NOW OUT! MODELS! ANIMATIONS! AND A NEW MAP!
notes.notes:
Wage war in a different way! 

Rise of Liberty now offers a choke point style map, which resembles the skirmishes on Prince Edward Island in 1777. The map offers a canyon theme, with a large surrounding body of water.

Minor updates;

-Newer melee animations

-All new AI animations

-New death animations

-Option to disable the cannons! Wage war with, or without the 6 pounders!

-New skybox!

-All new first-person animations
